name: Answer list
summary: The multiple-choice answer block on the audience phone: tappable rows on the frosted deck surface, single or multiple selection, the fixed 8px gap, live counts and the quiz reveal.
highlights: Multiple-choice answers on the audience phone
Single or multiple selection, counts and the quiz reveal
Locks and restores the pick after an iframe remount
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-answer-list> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Row
spec.value: min-height 48, radius 8, padding 8/16, gap 12; frosted surface (ink's opposite at 80% over a 20px blur), 1px ink hairline at 10%; a 16px margin above and below the list

spec.label: Pick
spec.value: 20px radio or checkbox with a 1px border (ink at 20% unchecked, the deck accent checked); a picked radio holds a 12px accent dot; my row ringed 1px in the deck ink; the keyboard focus ring is a 2px outline in the row ink, offset 2px

spec.label: Reveal
spec.value: a tick (success) or cross (error) on every row; the correct row ringed in success, my wrong pick ringed (2px) and tinted in error, the other rows mute to 55%

spec.label: Locked
spec.value: the rows I did not pick mute to 55% content opacity; my pick stays at full strength

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: lock-key
props.desc: The submission-lock key for this question: once a submission is locked under it, the element locks and restores the submitted value, including after an iframe remount

props.name: options
props.desc: The answers. Also settable as the `options` property

props.name: value
props.desc: The pick; an array of ids with selection-mode="multiple". Also the `value` property

props.name: quiz-status
props.desc: The host quiz phase (4 = Question, 5 = Result). Omit on a host with no quiz lifecycle

props.name: answered / revealed / awaiting-reveal
props.desc: The host's quiz flags: this phone answered; results are shown; the round ended with the verdict withheld

props.name: counts
props.desc: Per-option responder counts. Also the `counts` property

props.name: count-mode
props.desc: What the chip on each row shows; its box is kept when off, so revealing never relayouts

props.name: columns
props.desc: grid lays image-heavy rows out in columns measured from the list's own width

props.name: group-label
props.desc: The radiogroup's accessible name: pass the translated question

whenToUse.when: a fixed set of predefined answers the participant picks one or several of: nearly every quiz and poll
only rows that are not a plain list (split across columns, laid out on a board)
short toggles where several fit on a line
anything composed or positioned rather than picked: free text, a scale, an order, an image

opinion.note: Replaces a hand-built tappable answer row, which re-opens the submission lock, the deck ink, the frosted surface and the accent. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.

snippets.note: The native form — a version-pinned CDN import and plain HTML, for a build-less slide page.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the light-deck example with no deck applied (DS defaults).
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-answer-list[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;function q(s){return r&&r.querySelector(s)}function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var row=q('aha-answer-option').shadowRoot.querySelector('.row');var c=cs(row);var lab=cs(row&&row.querySelector('.label'));var picked=r.querySelectorAll('aha-answer-option')[1].shadowRoot.querySelector('.control');return{rowHeight:c.height,rowRadius:c.borderTopLeftRadius,ink:c.color,labelSize:lab.fontSize,gap:cs(q('.list')).rowGap,pickedControl:cs(picked).borderTopColor};})()
